situations.title: 소아 각성 사정
situations.tagline: He's just starting to wake up — let me check how alert he is before you come to his side.
keyPhrases: He's beginning to wake up now.
Let me check how alert and responsive he is.
You can come to his side in just a moment.

situations.title: 보호자 조기 면회
situations.tagline: Seeing a familiar face helps a lot — let's bring you to his bedside now that he's stable.
keyPhrases: A familiar face really helps him settle.
Come on over to his bedside now.
Talk to him gently — he can hear you.

situations.title: 안정 물건 제공
situations.tagline: Did he bring a favorite blanket or toy? Something familiar can really comfort him right now.
keyPhrases: Does he have a favorite blanket or stuffed animal?
Something familiar can be very comforting.
Let's tuck it right next to him.

situations.title: 소아 활력 감시
situations.tagline: I'm keeping a close watch on his heart rate, breathing, and oxygen as he wakes up.
keyPhrases: I'm watching his heart rate and oxygen closely.
His breathing looks comfortable and steady.
The monitor helps me keep him safe.

situations.title: 통증-섬망 구분 사정
situations.tagline: I'm checking whether he's in pain or just disoriented from waking up — they need different care.
keyPhrases: I'm figuring out if he's in pain or just disoriented.
Emergence confusion looks different from pain.
That tells me the right way to help him.

situations.title: 안전 환경 조성
situations.tagline: I've raised the side rails and cleared the area so he stays safe while he wakes up.
situations.brief: 소아를 위한 안전한 회복 환경을 조성하세요.
keyPhrases: The side rails are up to keep him safe.
I've cleared anything he could reach or pull.
Let's keep the area calm and quiet.

situations.title: 각성 섬망 인지
situations.tagline: He's thrashing and doesn't seem to know where he is — this is emergence delirium and it passes.
situations.brief: 소아 각성 섬망을 인지하고 보호자에게 설명하세요.
keyPhrases: This is called emergence delirium.
It's common in kids and it usually passes quickly.
He's safe — I'm right here keeping him from harm.

situations.title: 자극 최소 환경
situations.tagline: Let's dim the lights and keep voices low — too much stimulation makes the delirium worse.
keyPhrases: Let's dim the lights and keep it quiet.
Too much stimulation can worsen the delirium.
A calm, low voice helps him settle.

situations.title: 보호자 진정 협조
situations.tagline: Your calm voice can really help him settle — talk to him softly and hold his hand.
keyPhrases: Your calm voice really helps him settle.
Talk to him softly and hold his hand.
You're doing exactly the right thing.

situations.title: 낙상·자해 예방
situations.tagline: He's very restless — I'm keeping him from climbing over the rails or hurting himself.
keyPhrases: I'm keeping him from climbing the rails.
I won't let him pull at his lines.
Staying close keeps him from hurting himself.

situations.title: 진정제 필요 판단
situations.tagline: If the calming measures aren't enough, we may give a small dose of medication to settle him safely.
keyPhrases: If comfort measures aren't enough, we can give a little medication.
It's a small, safe dose to help him settle.
We'll watch his breathing closely afterward.

situations.title: 저산소·통증 원인 배제
situations.tagline: Before I call it just delirium, I'm ruling out low oxygen or pain as the cause.
situations.brief: 각성 섬망 전에 저산소와 통증 원인을 배제하세요.
keyPhrases: First I'm ruling out low oxygen or pain.
His oxygen looks good and I'm checking for pain.
That makes sure we treat the real cause.

situations.title: 소아 통증 동반 관리
situations.tagline: Part of this is pain, so I'm giving him something for comfort along with keeping him calm.
keyPhrases: Some of this is pain, so I'm treating that too.
Comfort medicine plus a calm environment helps.
We'll reassess how he responds.

situations.title: 라인·튜브 보호
situations.tagline: He keeps grabbing at the IV — I'm securing his lines so nothing gets pulled out.
keyPhrases: He keeps reaching for the IV.
I'm securing the lines so nothing gets pulled.
Can you gently hold his other hand?

situations.title: 회복 지연 감시
situations.tagline: He's taking a bit longer to fully wake — I'm watching him closely to make sure it's just slow recovery.
keyPhrases: He's taking a little longer to wake fully.
I'm watching him closely to be sure.
Some kids just recover more slowly.

situations.title: 심한 흥분 손상 위험
situations.tagline: He's extremely agitated and could hurt himself — I need help keeping him safe right now.
situations.brief: 심하게 흥분한 소아의 손상 위험에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's severely agitated and at risk of injury.
I need extra hands to keep him safe.
We're protecting him until he settles.

situations.title: 자가 발관 위험
situations.tagline: He's pulling at the airway — I have to stop him from extubating himself before it's safe.
keyPhrases: He's grabbing at the breathing tube.
I have to stop him from pulling it out.
Please hold his hands while I secure the airway.

situations.title: 저산소 원인 섬망
situations.tagline: His oxygen is dropping and that's driving the agitation — I'm treating the low oxygen first.
keyPhrases: His oxygen is dropping — that's causing the agitation.
I'm giving oxygen and opening his airway.
Treating the cause will calm him down.

situations.title: 진정 후 호흡 억제
situations.tagline: After the sedation his breathing slowed too much — I'm supporting his airway and giving oxygen now.
situations.brief: 진정 후 호흡 억제에 즉시 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His breathing slowed after the sedation.
I'm supporting his airway and giving oxygen.
We're right on top of it — he's safe.

situations.title: 지속 섬망 위기 대응
situations.tagline: The delirium isn't settling like usual — I'm escalating so we can get him safely through this.
keyPhrases: The delirium isn't settling as expected.
I'm getting the team involved to help.
We'll keep him safe until it resolves.

situations.title: 안전 사고 발생 대응
situations.tagline: He struck his hand during the episode — I'm assessing him and documenting exactly what happened.
situations.brief: 섬망 중 발생한 안전 사고에 대응하고 기록하세요.
keyPhrases: He hit his hand during the episode.
I'm checking him over for any injury.
I'll document exactly what happened and update the doctor.
